theorem mvcc.sc_mem (log ilog : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) (hrev : sint.Z rev < ↑(List.length log))
    (hilen : List.length ilog < 2 ^ 63) (hpre : log <+: ilog ∨ ilog <+: log) {m' : mvcc.Bucket}
    (hsub : ∀ (k v : GoString), m' !! k = some v → mvcc.bucketMap ilog !! k = some v) {k v :
    GoString} (hkv : m' !! k = some v) (r : mvcc.Rev) (t : Bool) (hk : k = mvcc.revBytes r t) (hm :
    sint.Z r.main ≤ sint.Z rev) : mvcc.sc_space log (sint.Z rev) k

theorem mvcc.sc_bucketMap_key (log : mvcc.Log) {k v : GoString} (h : mvcc.bucketMap log !! k = some
    v) : ∃ r i ch, r < List.length log ∧ (List.getD log r [])[i]? = some ch ∧ k = mvcc.revBytes {
    main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 ↑i } ch.isDel

theorem mvcc.sc_entry {ilog : mvcc.Log} (hcs : ∀ (cs : List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ ilog → cs.length < 2
    ^ 63) (hlen : List.length ilog < 2 ^ 63) {m' : mvcc.Bucket} (hsub : ∀ (k v : GoString), m' !! k
    = some v → mvcc.bucketMap ilog !! k = some v) (klo : GoString) (rev : w64) (hrev0 : 0 ≤ sint.Z
    rev) (hrev1 : sint.Z rev < 2 ^ 63 - 1) (n : Nat) {p : GoString × GoString} (hp : p ∈ List.take n
    (mvcc.bucketRange m' klo (u64Be (rev + W64 1)))) : ∃ r t, p.fst = mvcc.revBytes r t ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z
    r.main ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z r.sub ∧ sint.Z r.main ≤ sint.Z rev

theorem mvcc.sc_u64Be_lt_inv (a b : w64) (x : List w8) (h : go.GoStringLt (u64Be a ++ x) (u64Be b))
    : uint.Z a < uint.Z b

theorem mvcc.sc_sum_range (log : mvcc.Log) (n : Nat) : (List.map (fun r => (List.getD log r
    []).length) (List.range n)).sum = (List.map List.length (List.take n log)).sum

theorem mvcc.sc_keyDel (log : mvcc.Log) (rev : w64) (A : GMap
    go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.Revision Unit) (hA : mvcc.keepSetIs A log (sint.Z rev))
    (hrl : sint.Z rev < ↑(List.length log)) (r : mvcc.Rev) (t : Bool) (key : GoString) (hk : key =
    mvcc.revBytes r t) (h0 : 0 ≤ sint.Z r.main) (h1 : sint.Z r.main ≤ sint.Z rev) (hnot : (A !!
    mvcc.revVal r).isSome = false) : mvcc.KeyDel log (sint.Z rev) key

def mvcc.sc_space (log : mvcc.Log) (c : Int) (k : GoString) : Prop :=
  ∃ r i ch, ↑r ≤ c ∧ (List.getD log r [])[i]? = some ch ∧ k = mvcc.revBytes { main := W64 ↑r, sub := W64 ↑i } ch.isDel
